tools.name: upload_statements
tools.description: Single Orders are for businesses only (§ 14 BGB), no sale to consumers (§ 13 BGB). Consumers use a user account. Before the first upload, show your user the privacy notice: https://konverter-pro.de/de/datenschutz#ki-agenten (English: https://konverter-pro.de/en/datenschutz#ai-agents). Start a conver

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Per file: processing state, KP's checks (pages and bookings read, balance check, all records read), readiness for the target format with blockers, open questions and the next step. Poll every few seconds until every file is read.

tools.name: list_open_questions
tools.description: Bookings KP could not assign to an account with certainty, grouped like KP's review (by booking type, counterparty or single booking), each with KP's proposal, count, total and examples. Answer them with answer_questions.

tools.name: answer_questions
tools.description: Assign an account (4-8 digits, the user's chart) to whole question groups. For a booking type the answer is stored as a rule for later files unless remember=false: within this job for anonymous jobs, for the client profile's future files with an API key. A revenue account on a group with direction e

tools.name: get_preview
tools.description: A preview of the output. In a job without an API key it is free and covers an unpaid file's first 5 pages with bookings or first 125 bookings (all bookings of a smaller file; PDF bookings without a page are left out). Its file name marks it as not for bookkeeping; it serves only to check the result.

tools.name: get_price_quote
tools.description: Single Orders are for businesses only (§ 14 BGB), no sale to consumers (§ 13 BGB). Consumers use a user account. The price of the job's ready, unpaid files: units (1 page with bookings, or 25 bookings) x unit price, with a minimum per payment, net plus VAT. With a KP API key the customer's plan pays

tools.name: create_payment_link
tools.description: Single Orders are for businesses only (§ 14 BGB), no sale to consumers (§ 13 BGB). Consumers use a user account. A Stripe payment page for the quoted files (card, invoice with VAT). Show the link to your user; once paid, download_result releases the final files. A new link replaces the previous one.

tools.name: download_result
tools.description: The final file (DATEV Buchungsstapel, Lexware CSV or MT940) once it is ready and paid (or covered by the API key's plan). Returns download links valid for 1 hour, at most until the job ends, and KP's check report. DATEV needs datev.berater_nummer and datev.mandanten_nummer for anonymous jobs; MT940

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "answer_questions" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Assign an account (4-8 digits, the user's chart) to whole question groups. For a booking type the answer is stored as a rule for later files unless remember=fal…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_open_questions · Private data: upload_statements, get_job_status, answer_questions, get_preview, get_price_quote, create_payment_link, download_result · Public sink: upload_statements, answer_questions · Destructive: get_job_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_open_questions · Private data: upload_statements, get_job_status, answer_questions, get_preview, get_price_quote, create_payment_link, download_result · Public sink: upload_statements, answer_questions · Destructive: get_job_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "upload_statements" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
